## Directory Tree

```
<workspace-root>/
├── src/                    # [describe: e.g., application source code]
│   ├── [module-a]/         # [purpose]
│   │   ├── [sub-folder]/   # [purpose]
│   │   └── index.ts        # [purpose]
│   ├── [module-b]/         # [purpose]
│   └── [shared]/           # [purpose: e.g., shared utilities, types]
├── tests/                  # [or co-located — describe policy]
├── docs/                   # Documentation
│   └── rules/              # AI steering documents
├── [config-folder]/        # [e.g., .github, .kiro, .claude]
├── [infra-folder]/         # [e.g., terraform, k8s manifests]
├── package.json            # Dependencies and scripts
└── README.md
```

## Naming Conventions

| Artifact | Convention | Example |
|----------|-----------|---------|
| Files (components) | [e.g., PascalCase] | `UserCard.tsx` |
| Files (utilities) | [e.g., camelCase] | `formatDate.ts` |
| Files (constants) | [e.g., SCREAMING_SNAKE] | `API_ENDPOINTS.ts` |
| Directories | [e.g., kebab-case] | `user-profile/` |
| Test files | [e.g., `*.test.ts` co-located] | `UserCard.test.tsx` |
| Types/interfaces | [e.g., PascalCase, no `I` prefix] | `UserProfile` |
| CSS classes | [e.g., BEM / Tailwind utility] | `user-card__avatar` |

## Module Boundaries

<!-- Define what is allowed to import what. Prevents circular deps and enforces layering. -->

```
[layer-a] → can import from: [layer-b], [shared]
[layer-b] → can import from: [shared]
[shared]  → no internal imports
```

<!-- Example for a feature-sliced design:
  features/ → can import from: shared/, entities/
  entities/ → can import from: shared/
  shared/   → no internal imports
-->

## Co-location Policy

<!-- Describe where tests, styles, and types live relative to the code they relate to. -->

- Tests: [e.g., co-located next to source files as `*.test.ts`]
- Styles: [e.g., co-located as `*.module.css` / global in `src/styles/`]
- Types: [e.g., co-located in `types.ts` per module / centralized in `src/types/`]
- Generated files: [e.g., `src/generated/` — do not edit manually]

## Special Files & Folders

<!-- Call out any non-obvious files AI tools should know about. -->

- `[file]` — [purpose and any editing rules]
- `[folder]/` — [purpose; e.g., "auto-generated by Prisma — do not edit"]
